entities.summary: Ragnvald Heidumhære was a semi-historical petty king or chieftain of Vestfold in what is today Norway in the 9th century, according to Ynglingatal and to Ynglinga saga in Heimskringla. He was apparently a member of the Yngling clan. His name Heiðumhæri could be translated as highly honoured

entities.summary: Ragnvald Heidumhære was a semi-historical petty king or chieftain of Vestfold in what is today Norway in the 9th century, according to Ynglingatal and to Ynglinga saga in Heimskringla.
